description: Defines a utility enum GatewayPayloadDecoding with static methods for decoding payloads conforming to Decodable from an AnyCodable type, including handling optional decoding.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a payload of type AnyCodable into a Decodable type T, encoding first to JSON data then decoding.

methods.name: decodeIfPresent
methods.description: Decodes an optional payload into a Decodable type T, returning nil if payload is nil.
